name: sensorpro-mcp
description: MCP server (stdio) for the SensorPro email marketing REST API: contacts, campaigns, segments, designs, broadcasts, relay email and imports.
author: SensorPro

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/sensorpro-mcp.js --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="import { createRequire as __spCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __spCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: node test/stdio-test.mjs && node test/fake-server-test.mjs ok && node test/fake-server-test.mjs badcreds && node test/fake-server-test.mjs ip
